{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the status values
print("Status values:", sales_df['status'].unique())

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
